hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.mdx ]] && [[ "$FILE" == *articles* ]]; then echo "[Hook] Validating article frontmatter..."; if ! head -50 "$FILE" | grep -q "^title:"; then echo "WARNING: Missing title in frontmatter"; fi; if ! head -50 "$FILE" | grep -q "^description:"; then echo "WARNING: Missing description in frontmatter"; fi; if ! head -50 "$FILE" | grep -q "^category:"; then echo "WARNING: Missing category in frontmatter"; fi; if ! head -50 "$FILE" | grep -q "^tags:"; then echo "WARNING: Missing tags in frontmatter"; fi; if ! head -50 "$FILE" | grep -q "^date:"; then echo "WARNING: Missing date in frontmatter"; fi; echo "[Hook] Article validation complete."; fi'
